meta.title: KUL Enterprises | Reliable Freight Transportation Built on Trust
meta.description: KUL Enterprises LLC is a licensed and insured freight carrier based in {location}. Power Only, Dry Van, Reefer, Dedicated, Regional, Expedited, and Over-the-Road service. Southeast based, nationwide. USDOT {usdot}, MC {mc}.

hero.lede: Freight services out of {location}, authorized in 48 states, dispatched by the person driving.

statement.heading: You will always be talking to the driver.
statement.body: Dispatch at KUL is Mark Brown. He drove for other carriers for eleven years before starting it.

services.heading: Seven ways to move it.
services.note: If a lane needs more capacity than we can commit to, we will tell you before you book rather than after.

vision.heading: We grow the fleet before we sell the capacity.
vision.body: Written in the order it has to happen, with a date against nothing until it is booked.

journey.eyebrow: Five acts · the story so far
journey.heading: Before the first truck, there was a boy on a plane.
journey.body: Jamaica. Construction sites every school holiday. The Air Force. Eleven years driving for other people. The Journey is the long version, in Mark's own words.
